STATIC

A mystery-horror adventure game concept created by Dmitrii Zhukov. Based on the original novel Myst, combining psychological thriller and survival horror genres with immersive investigation mechanics, branching narrative, stealth gameplay, and over-the-shoulder hand-to-hand combat.

My name is Dmitrii Zhukov, I am a game writer. I design worlds, lore, and narrative experiences that blend mystery, emotion, and player agency. From memorable characters and branching storylines to detective plots and carefully crafted twists, I build stories that reward curiosity and culminate in meaningful catharsis. My game concept Static adapts the world and story of myoriginal novel "Myst".
